lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 13 distinct white vertical lines; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section and becomes tighter as lines approach the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One bifurcation is observed on the third line from the anterior, splitting near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 1, 11, 12, and 13 appear as discontinuous segments or dashed lines that fail to traverse the full vertical extent of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A grouping of 5-6 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the posterior haunch align along a horizontal axis, following the contour of the upper thigh.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking between the eyes, dual white spots on the cheek, and white bands visible on the fetlock region of both front and hind legs.
